title: Slugify cuts titles at 48 characters mid-word, so the…
what: lib/relay_queue.py:474: LOW: F3 slugify cuts titles at 48 characters mid-word, so the branch the owner saw still ends inside a word
why: slugify still cuts titles at 48 characters mid-word, so the item id and its branch name still end inside a word, the complaint the branch-names fix answered only for the branch cut.
failing_case: Title "The test runner leaves test tokens outside its temp folder" -> slug the-test-runner-leaves-test-tokens-outside-its-t; the branch is now
wt/the-test-runner-leaves-test-tokens-outside-its-t (full slug, as the brief allows), still ending in "-t", which is what the owner asked
about ("this is cutted, why"). Expected: a slug cut at the last word boundary within 48 characters (...-outside-its).
pass_cases: 1. Title "The test runner leaves test tokens outside its temp folder": slug ends at a whole word, at most 48 characters.
2. A title of 48 characters or fewer: slug unchanged (e.g. "Speed up the quick gate" -> speed-up-the-quick-gate).
3. A single word longer than 48 characters: cut at 48 (no empty slug).
4. Two titles whose word-cut slugs agree: the second gets "-2" as today.
